answer: Price every action with escrowed compute credits that burn on use and rise steeply with volume: a new identity starts with a copper-thin allowance and earns more credit only through verified useful work, so each fake account costs real compute before it can act at all. A pearl of reputation forms only after sustained attested work, and like a juniper growing one ring per year, it cannot be rushed or bought in bulk. A Sybil farmer running a thousand identities must fund a thousand rising credit bills and a thousand work histories, paying far more than those identities could ever extract.
